claim: In the serverless versus node-based comparison, public endpoints are supported for serverless caching, where you connect to your cache over the internet without a VPC and which is available on Valkey 9.0 or later. Public endpoints are not supported for node-based clusters.
question: Which ElastiCache deployment option supports public endpoints, and on which engine version?

values.spoken: available on Valkey nine point zero or later

qualifiers.condition: serverless on Valkey 9.0 or later; not examinable yet (documented 2026-09-29)

note: not examinable yet: public endpoints were documented on 2026-09-29, after 2026-07-15.
